title: Conditional κ = 8.04939789231485e-4: 123 coupled frame changes after #364 (+0.00751%)
body:
Conditional **κ = 160987957846297 / 200000000000000000 = 8.04939789231485e-4**, improving frozen PR364's `8.04879370798932e-4` by **0.007506520200%**.

The final Design T/min-cost-carrier word admits 123 coupled ADD-frame changes in 35 beneficial components: 71 dimension-13 frames become dimension 12, and 52 dimension-15 frames become dimension 14. Every signed scalar instruction and its order, register, COPY window, entrance and endpoint is preserved. The local paid-call count decreases by 17, with unchanged rank mass and helper stock. The E8 complex supplier is unchanged; the bit side still binds.

The package vendors PR364 at immutable commit `f8c6a47abfec24b87cb1eb0a138dd73dfce2abe4`, preserving its full manifests and notices. A source-bound selection, reconstruction, exact price, proof and dedicated Python 3.11/3.12 workflow are included. Candidate discovery used the prior campaign's free-form annealer and a bounded CP-SAT solve, followed by exact component reduction and compatibility checking; floating-point search scores are not certificate inputs.

**Validation:** the complete immutable PR364 replay and fresh final standalone replay passed locally. All 58 GitHub checks passed at head `d3d84202e528d6e147a8ea62463ae5c0125997cf`, including the dedicated full certificate replays on Python 3.11 and 3.12 ([run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38111725043)). Checks cover exact signed-instruction identity, frame/source-span and dirty-helper restoration, nondegeneracy of all 53 new frames, native five-stage formal columns and negative controls, historical reconstruction, bank tiling, both rational pricing engines and all 47 strict outer inequalities. The adjacent κ tick is rejected.

```sh
python -m pip install -r research/w3-design-t-mc-coupled-retiming/requirements.txt
python -B research/w3-design-t-mc-coupled-retiming/verify.py /fresh/output
```

The compiler, common-chart, restored-row, selector/routing, prime-supply, precision/recovery and analytic-transfer interfaces remain inherited assumptions. This is a conditional finite-word improvement, not an unconditional integer-multiplication theorem, a global optimum, or a new Lean certificate.

Credit includes DreamingOfClouds, Chafik Boukhalfa, Jacob Sussman, the prior Rohan Arun research campaign and all contributors named in the retained notices. New selection, exact component reduction, integration and verification were prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. New contributions are Apache-2.0.

The three-file source-pin repair from PR318 (`a45747d2559141a594916475f52642e4fab86e02`) is included unchanged. Every pinned input matches current main. This addresses the inherited joint-dual CI failure without changing its mathematics.
